item.title: Trees/vegitation still causing possible blockage on Hatherley Brook, just downstream of bridge in Meadow Close, 4th August
item.description:
This problem was reported by me a month or so ago and it is obvious that nothing has been done about it. There have been problems in the past in this area after very heavy rainfall and since I moved here in 2022, I have seen Hatherley Brook water level rise to just under the bridge.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 1, Meadow Close, Hatherley, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
